facts.text: Hobart and William Smith Colleges was originally founded as two separate institutions—Hobart for men and William Smith for women—and today operates united with one campus, one faculty, and one administration.

sources.title: About Us - Hobart and William Smith Colleges
sources.quote: Originally founded as two institutions — Hobart for men and William Smith for women — today's institution – Hobart and William Smith – is united with one campus, one faculty and one administration.

facts.text: Hobart and William Smith Colleges guarantees an internship or research placement for its students.

sources.title: Salisbury Center for Career, Professional and Experiential Education
sources.quote: We were among the first colleges to guarantee an internship or research placement and it was a shocking idea at the time.
